observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment ECI session activity projection

outcome.limitation: The session accountability projection reported only an empty agent-declared readiness scope while Environment owner-pass decisions and results were available through a separate projection. Agents had to correlate the two views to inspect Environment-owned service work.
outcome.evidence_interpretation: This is a projection integration gap. It does not establish that any owner pass failed or that an agent opportunity was missed.
outcome.recurrence: one campaign-session observation; recurrence across independent sessions is not established

pressure_hypothesis.title: Service accountability omitted Environment-owned pass evidence when session readiness scope was empty
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: mncs-environment capability intelligence and incremental coherence
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Connect the existing Environment owner-pass contract and exact trace digest to service-accountability projections when readiness services are empty or unrecorded, while keeping scheduler decision coverage distinct from agent need, service fulfillment, and burden reduction.

related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign

measurement_limits: The prior ECI view and owner-pass snapshot were not independently established as the same snapshot revision; no same-revision causal claim is made.
A scheduler decision is not an agent-need opportunity. No missed opportunity, agent receipt, intervention burden, or service correctness is inferred.
Only one campaign session is represented; cross-session recurrence and other ambient service domains remain unmeasured.
